candidate_clauses.normative_text: When RequirementMode is CURRENT_REQUIRED, the evaluator MUST consume a canonical evaluation-time CurrentBasisStateSnapshot for each applicable BasisType/effect pair, keyed to the exact basis revision evaluated. The normalized basis-validity domain is {VALID, STALE, INVALID}; TERMINAL is not a basis-validity value and remains an operational Reservation state. VALID satisfies CURRENT_REQUIRED. STALE or INVALID fails the current-validity requirement and resolves to BLOCK unless an explicitly selected typed PropagationPolicy maps that current-state outcome to another permitted propagation action. A missing or unresolvable current-state snapshot MUST resolve to NOT_EVALUATED before propagation arbitration. Contradictory current-state snapshots for the same BasisType and basis revision are malformed input and MUST resolve to REJECT. The evaluation-time CurrentBasisStateSnapshot is semantically distinct from the commit-time concurrency compare-set and MUST NOT be used interchangeably with it.

rm5_traceability_policy.reserved_cases_rule: Missing/reserved case IDs in G2-ID-195..201 remain explicitly unresolved and are never promoted to exact execution evidence.
rm5_traceability_policy.stage_reason_rule: The RM5 rebuild does not upgrade clause evidence to stage/reason exactness where executor output differs from fixture expected stage/reason. Such dimensions remain open.

semantic_review_resolutions.source_parent_value_verbatim: Inherited v0.4 resolutions remain historical; v0.6 adds new candidate resolutions only; no deletion of frozen records.

supersession_rule: A successor registry becomes normative only through explicit authorization and freeze; predecessor identity and sha256 must be exact.

traceability_closure.method: Rebuild every traceability declaration from the current final carrier only. Never convert ALIAS, RELATED, or legacy references into EXACT. A fixture is EXACT only when the declared fixture_id exists in the current 202-fixture suite. A receipt is EXACT only when its exact bytes are present in the active evidence set and the hash is recomputable. Governance invariant references remain unverifiable when no canonical invariant registry is supplied.
traceability_closure.semantic_equivalence_basis: 45-clause semantic core is unchanged from RM5; affected inherited clauses also unchanged against G2-NORMATIVE-0.8-FROZEN where source evidence originated.

traceability_contract.fixture_requirement: RFEC behavioral clauses MUST have >=1 executable fixture; governance-only clauses MAY have 0 fixtures only when governance_fixture_exemption is explicit.

adjudication_basis: RM7R registry_identity parent id and sha256 exactly resolve to RM5.
RM5 itself declares RM3A as its parent with the same RM3A SHA-256 carried by RM7R top-level parent fields.
The explicit RM5-to-RM7R carrier migration record in MIGFIX02 binds RM5 as historical source and RM7R as target.

Therefore the unique historical chain supported by exact bytes is RM3A -> RM5 -> RM7R; the RM7R top-level parent_registry_version=RM3A value is retained only as an immutable historical conflict, not as the active immediate-parent interpretation.
